title: Chrome Web Store listing manifest
description: Content for the Chrome Web Store Developer Dashboard listing, referenced by a chrome target's `store` field in release.yaml. The Chrome Web Store API cannot upload any of this (see scripts/store-assets.mjs); it exists so the release job can bundle it into a store-listing-<app>-<version>.zip artifact for a human to paste into the dashboard by hand. Screenshot and promo image paths are relative to this manifest's own file, not the repo root.

shortDescription.description: Dashboard 'Short description' field (shown in search results). Max 132 characters.

description.description: Dashboard 'Description' field (the full listing body). Max 16000 characters.

category.description: Dashboard 'Category' field, e.g. "Developer Tools". Not validated against the Store's category list.

screenshots.description: 1-5 screenshots, in the order they should be uploaded. Each must be a 1280x800 or 640x400 PNG or JPEG.

assetPath.patternHint: a path relative to this manifest's own directory (not the repo root); '..' is fine
